stories.headline: Set up OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES to track Claude Code usage by team
stories.summary: Claude Code v2.1.161 now includes OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES values as labels on metric datapoints. This allows you to slice and analyze usage metrics by custom dimensions like team, repository, or project. Essential for organizations wanting to track and optimize Claude usage across different groups.
actionable_steps: Set the OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES environment variable with your desired labels (e.g., 'team=backend,repo=api-service')
Restart Claude Code to apply the new resource attributes
Check your metrics dashboard to verify the new labels appear on datapoints
Create queries or dashboards filtering by your custom dimensions

stories.headline: Configure `disallowed-tools` in skill frontmatter to restrict model access
stories.summary: You can prevent Claude from using specific tools while a skill is active by declaring them in the skill's frontmatter. This gives you fine-grained control over tool availability during skill execution.
actionable_steps: Save the file and reload skills with `/reload-skills`
Test that the specified tools are unavailable when the skill is active

stories.headline: Use /usage command to track Claude Code resource consumption by category
stories.summary: The /usage command now provides detailed breakdowns of what's consuming your usage limits, including skills, subagents, plugins, and MCP server costs. This helps identify which features are driving your resource consumption for better optimization.
actionable_steps: Review the per-category breakdown showing skills, subagents, plugins, and MCP-server costs
Identify high-usage categories to optimize your workflow

stories.headline: Use safe-mode flag to troubleshoot Claude Code issues
stories.summary: When Claude Code behaves unexpectedly, safe mode disables all customizations including CLAUDE.md files, plugins, skills, hooks, and MCP servers. This helps isolate whether issues stem from your configurations or the base application.
actionable_steps: Test if your issue persists in safe mode
If the issue disappears, gradually re-enable customizations to identify the culprit

stories.headline: Configure persistent Claude Code settings using ~/.claude/settings.json
stories.summary: Claude Code now saves your /config preferences (theme, editor mode, verbose output) to a persistent file instead of resetting each session. This eliminates the need to reconfigure your preferences every time you start Claude Code.
actionable_steps: Run Claude Code and use /config to set your preferred theme, editor mode, and other settings
Verify settings are saved to ~/.claude/settings.json file
Test persistence by restarting Claude Code and confirming settings remain
